deliberation_set.description: Every ticker that reached >=2 nominations (D-2) or lens top tier, event-filter-cleared, entering deliberation

bear_case.description: MANDATORY (RB:committee.bear_case_mandatory; performance.committee.bear_case_present_pct_min=100) — the strongest reason NOT to take this name, stated plainly, even on an ADVANCE

dissent.description: Recorded, never suppressed — empty array is a valid outcome (true unanimity), not an assumed default

conditions.description: Required (non-null) when verdict is HOLD-FOR-CONDITIONS; null otherwise
